entropy_degraded/tainted.recovery: The tainted samples are complete. They stay in the run, they are excluded from the analysis under the registered rule, and Resume does not generate them again. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check then counts again from zero.

entropy_degraded/probe.recovery: The tainted samples are complete. They stay in the run, they are excluded from the analysis under the registered rule, and Resume does not generate them again. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check then counts again from zero.

tier0_failed/arm.sentence: 10 samples in a row on arm prng7 have no usable token records.
tier0_failed/arm.recovery: Those samples are complete and Resume does not generate them again. A sample tainted for its token records is excluded from the analysis under the registered rule. A sample flagged for a missing token log keeps its reply, score and judgement and has no token records. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check then counts again from zero.

scorer_errors/card.sentence: The scorer of card psychobench failed on 10 samples in a row.
scorer_errors/card.recovery: The samples whose scorer failed are complete and have no score. The harness does not score a stored reply again, so Resume cannot recover them. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check then counts again from zero.

empty_outputs/card.sentence: The last 20 replies stored for card eval_awareness were all empty. They came from 5 prompts, and 3 arms each gave at least 5 of them.
empty_outputs/card.recovery: An empty reply is a complete sample: it stays in the run and in the analysis and Resume does not generate it again. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check is not applied to the card again in this run.

nothing_parsed/first.sentence: None of the first 30 scored samples of card psychobench gave an answer the card's scorer could extract. They cover 5 prompts.
nothing_parsed/first.recovery: Those samples are complete: they stay in the run as they are, and Resume neither generates nor scores them again. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check is not applied to the card again in this run.

nothing_parsed/queue_end.sentence: Card psychobench came to the end of its queue with 12 scored samples and none of them gave an answer the card's scorer could extract.
nothing_parsed/queue_end.recovery: Those samples are complete: they stay in the run as they are, and Resume neither generates nor scores them again. Resume goes on with the samples that are left. This check is not applied to the card again in this run.

unfinished/generation.sentence: Generation reached the end of its queue with 49 of 80 planned samples without a completed reply, in 2 arm and card pairs.
unfinished/generation.recovery: Resume tries every sample that has no completed reply, and every judgement that has no reply, again. This check stops a run once for generation and once for judging: if samples are still missing when that part ends again, the run goes on without them.

unfinished/judge.sentence: Judging reached the end of its queue with 12 of 40 judgements without a reply from the judge, in 1 arm and card pairs.
unfinished/judge.recovery: Resume tries every sample that has no completed reply, and every judgement that has no reply, again. This check stops a run once for generation and once for judging: if samples are still missing when that part ends again, the run goes on without them.

judge_rejected/preflight.sentence: The judge answered the request made before the first generation with HTTP status 400: it did not accept the key, the model or the settings.
judge_rejected/preflight.recovery: Nothing that was generated or judged is lost. Supply a judge key that works and Resume: every judgement that has no reply is asked again. The judge model and its settings are frozen in the study, so Resume cannot fix a model or a setting the provider refuses. This check is made again after Resume.

judge_rejected/judge.sentence: The judge answered a request with HTTP status 401: it did not accept the key, the model or the address.
judge_rejected/judge.recovery: Nothing that was generated or judged is lost. Supply a judge key that works and Resume: every judgement that has no reply is asked again. judge_unusable/streak.recovery: Judgements that got a reply are kept. Resume asks every judgement that has no reply again. This check then counts again from zero.

judge_unusable/share.sentence: 14 of the last 20 judge calls got no reply.
judge_unusable/share.recovery: Judgements that got a reply are kept. Resume asks every judgement that has no reply again. This check then counts again from zero.

nothing_judged/card.sentence: No score could be read from any of the first 30 judge replies for card eval_awareness.
nothing_judged/card.recovery: A reply that was received is final: those replies are kept without a score and the judge is not asked again for them. Resume goes on with the judgements that are left. This check is not applied to the card again in this run.

judge_phase_error/run.sentence: The judge phase ended on an error the harness did not expect.
judge_phase_error/run.recovery: Every row already written is kept. Resume starts the judge phase again and asks every judgement that has no reply. If the same error comes back the run stops again: this check is never switched off.

flag_kinds.label: empty reply
flag_kinds.sentence: The reply has no visible text: once one reasoning block at its start is set aside, nothing is left but whitespace and invisible characters.

flag_kinds.label: ended at the token limit
flag_kinds.sentence: The reply ended because it reached the token limit.

flag_kinds.label: ends in a loop
flag_kinds.sentence: The reply ends in a loop: the same text of 1 to 200 characters repeated at least 8 times in a row over at least 240 characters. A last copy that is cut short counts as one of the 8, and whitespace at the end of the reply is ignored.

flag_kinds.label: damaged characters
flag_kinds.sentence: The reply has at least 20 characters, and at least 5% of them, and at least 3, are replacement characters or control characters other than tab, newline and carriage return, which is what broken text decoding leaves behind.

flag_kinds.label: reasoning in the reply
flag_kinds.sentence: The reply starts with a <think> tag, or has a </think> tag with no <think> before it, so reasoning text sits where the answer should be.

flag_kinds.label: no token log
flag_kinds.sentence: In a run whose token records come from the engine's token log, the request asked the engine for a token log and none arrived; or, in any run, a token came back without a log-probability. No token records were written for the sample. Its reply, score and judgement stand.

flag_kinds.label: draw outside its bracket
flag_kinds.sentence: For at least one token the random draw lies outside the probability bracket of the token that was sampled. A healthy engine cannot produce this.

flag_kinds.label: scorer failed
flag_kinds.sentence: The card's scorer raised an error or returned a value that cannot be stored, so the sample has no score.

flag_kinds.label: answer not extracted
flag_kinds.sentence: The card's scorer reports that it could not extract an answer from the reply.

flag_kinds.label: no judge reply
flag_kinds.sentence: The judge gave no reply for the sample: the request failed, or the harness could not build the judge prompt or read the reply's fields. The judgement is asked again when the run is resumed.

flag_kinds.label: judge reply without a score
flag_kinds.sentence: The judge replied and no score could be read from the reply. The reply is kept without a score and the judge is not asked again.

flag_kinds.label: judge score not allowed
flag_kinds.sentence: The score read from the judge's reply is not one of the values the rubric allows. The reply is kept without a score and the judge is not asked again.

flag_kinds.label: judge reply cut short
flag_kinds.sentence: The judge's reply did not end normally, so it may be incomplete.
